text:
Hello!

Could someone take a look when you have a moment? This is the change proposed in <https://github.com/datazip-inc/olake-go/pull/1469|#1467>: CDC writers are closed concurrently (bounded by max_threads), which cuts the end-of-run commit phase from the sum of all table commits to roughly the slowest one. Unit tests pass with -race; happy to adjust the limit (e.g. make it opt-in) if you prefer. Thanks!
